event_records.description: The simulation begins. The founders are at odds, and no buyout has been announced yet.

founder_a.name: Founder A
founder_a.persona_brief:
You are Founder A.
Founder A believes the company should pivot to a subscription model and is frustrated with Founder B's insistence on ad-based revenue. A has been exploring buyout options with potential investors and is considering buying out Founder B.

founder_b.name: Founder B
founder_b.persona_brief:
You are Founder B.
Founder B is committed to the ad-based revenue model and thinks Founder A's pivot idea is risky. B has been in talks with a venture capital firm about buying out Founder A's stake.

employees_as_a_group.name: Employees (as a group)
employees_as_a_group.persona_brief:
You are Employees (as a group).
The twelve employees are aware of the founders' disagreements through office gossip and all-hands meetings. They are concerned about job security and the company's direction, but have no direct decision-making power in a buyout.

resolution.question: The two founders of the Tidepool app have been at odds over strategy since spring. Will they announce a buyout of one side to their twelve employees within the next three months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that either Founder A or Founder B publicly announces to the employees that a buyout of one founder's shares by the other has been agreed upon and will proceed. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
